title: test_sos_resource.py: Resource leak: client context never shut down in 4 tests
description:
Tests test_retrigger_noop_when_idle (line 268), test_beacon_task_starts_on_activate (line 301), test_beacon_task_stops_on_cancel (line 312), and test_beacon_retriggers_periodically (line 326) all call _setup() which creates a client context, but assign it to _ and never call shutdown() on it. All other tests in this file properly shut down both client and server in finally blocks. This can cause event loop warnings about unclosed transports and pending tasks, and may cause test hangs or flakiness in CI environments with strict resource tracking.

File: python/tests/coap/test_sos_resource.py
Line: 268
